description.value: You always have @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplTelekinesi]{Telekinesis} prepared. With this feature, you can cast it without a spell slot or components, and Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it. On each of your turns while you maintain Concentration on it, including the turn you cast it, you can make one attack with a weapon as a Bonus Action. Once you cast the spell this way, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to restore it.
